mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0 percentage points, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in retail sales and housing starts indicates strengthening consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST increase by ≥0.5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime defined by negative quarterly GDP growth, declining corporate earnings and heightened risk aversion produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of negative GDP growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO uptrend periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS > 5.0 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month payroll growth and unemployment rate decline indicate a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods where PAYEMS ↑ and UNRATE ↓ by ≥0.1pp MoM, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recovery supply expansion regime defined by industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% monthly, accelerating manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO growth >1.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
